about_the_game:
Enhance your experience of MODULAR with the official Soundtrack — a handpicked collection of original tracks crafted to complement the game's unique atmosphere. Whether you're reliving your favorite in-game moments or simply vibing to the music on its own, this soundtrack is designed to stand strong both inside and outside the game.

🎧 Features:

  • High-quality MP3 (and optionally WAV) files

  • Original music composed for MODULAR

  • Includes in-game tracks

  • Perfect for relaxed listening, creativity, or nostalgia

  • More songs or sounds may be added over time

Treat your ears to the official sounds of MODULAR — and stay tuned for possible future additions!
